steps.title: Plan the edit
steps.prompt:
Brief: {{inputs.brief}}

Takes: {{steps.inventory.output_path}}. Transcript with word times: {{run.dir}}/words.json. Write {{run.dir}}/edit-plan.md: takes to use and their order, every cut with source times, graphics cues, and the length estimate. Do not touch the footage.

steps.title: Approve the edit plan
steps.gate_summary: Read {{run.dir}}/edit-plan.md. Approve to cut and render; reject stops the run before any render.

steps.title: Cut and render
steps.prompt: Follow {{run.dir}}/edit-plan.md on the takes in {{inputs.footage}}. Cut fillers, false starts and silences over 400 ms at word boundaries with 30 ms fades, add the overlays, and render {{run.dir}}/edit/rough.mp4. If {{run.dir}}/flags.json exists, fix the flagged cuts you can first. Then burn captions, duck the music bed, and render {{run.dir}}/out/final.mp4 plus a 9:16 centre crop. Mark a flag you cannot settle as left for you. Never edit the source takes.

steps.title: Check every cut
steps.prompt: Check the newest render in {{run.dir}}/out/ or {{run.dir}}/edit/. At every cut, look at frames and the waveform in a 3 s window: jump cuts, clipped words, pops, rushed cuts. Write each problem to {{run.dir}}/flags.json with its cut id and time. Set passed to true when no flag is left that the edit step can fix, otherwise false.

steps.title: Watch and approve the cut
steps.gate_summary: Watch {{run.dir}}/out/final.mp4. Flags left for you: {{steps.edit.outputs.flags_left}}. Approve to finish; reject cancels the run.
